notes: Machine-readable mirror of the authoritative budget table in docs/dev/features.md section 0.5.3.
Every value here is cross-checked against that table by `xtask budget --validate`; a mismatch fails the gate.
Units: latency_ms = milliseconds, memory_mb = mebibytes of RSS, cpu_pct = percent of one core, size_mb = mebibytes, *_count = occurrences, net_sockets = process-external sockets.

`bench` holds the per-case thresholds the criterion benchmarks are asserted against. They are not cross-cutting budgets, so they are not rows of the 0.5.3 table: each one is stated by the acceptance criterion of the card that owns the case, and `xtask budget --validate` cross-checks every value against that criterion the same way it cross-checks the table.
Units in `bench` are carried by the field name: `*_ns` nanoseconds, `*_us` microseconds, `*_s` seconds.

`xtask budget --measure` asserts the two `size_mb` thresholds against the release artifacts `just package` writes into `dist/`. The thresholds live here and nowhere else: the packager reads them from this file to measure and to record them in `rspinyin-release.json`, so a ceiling and the artifact it governs cannot drift apart.
